Single-Page MCMC Diagnostics

Source: R/diagnostics.R
diagnostics.Rd

Single-Page MCMC Diagnostics

Usage

diagnostics(
  object,
  pars = NULL,
  labels = NULL,
  study_labels = NULL,
  model_label = NULL,
  ndraws = 100,
  font = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

object

A fitted model: brmsfit, stanfit (rstan / MetaStan), CmdStanMCMC (cmdstanr), or stanreg.

pars

Character vector of parameters for the trace / autocorrelation panels (given as ORIGINAL parameter names). Default selects the population-level effect and between-study SD.

labels

Optional named vector mapping original parameter names to display labels, e.g. c(b_Intercept = "\u03bc", sd_Author__Intercept = "\u03c4"). Overrides the automatic mu / tau defaults.

study_labels

Optional named vector mapping study keys to display labels, e.g. as built by make_study_labels().

model_label

Optional character string naming the model, shown in the diagnostics page title.

ndraws

Draws used in the posterior predictive panel.

font

Font family for panel text.

...

Unused.

Value

A patchwork object (the assembled diagnostic page).
